svg.title: Windgram — forecast profiles for soaring
svg.desc: The Windgram wordmark and tagline beside a package-rendered windgram of a complete convective cycle.

svg.aria-label: Windgram for Synthetic Ridge, model convective-cycle, 2000-01-01 10a to 7p (Etc/UTC): surface metric strips above a time-height field; derived series, isotherms, shading overlays and winds aloft are drawn over the profile.
